review.note: Retracted in M21, and the most regrettable retraction of the decade: 8 November 1925 was the last multi-party election in Portugal until the Constituent Assembly of 1975. One argument runs out of it — the parliament it returned is the one 28 May 1926 swept away — but nothing argued runs in, and a single edge does not meet the bar. Its significance is a fact about the fifty years after it, not a consequence of it.
